description: Source code for the PSNames module implementation in FreeType, handling PostScript glyph name and Unicode mappings, including optional Adobe Glyph List support.

methods.name: ps_unicode_value
methods.description: Converts a glyph name to its Unicode value, handling 'uni', 'u', and variant names with dots.

methods.name: compare_uni_maps
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting Unicode maps, prioritizing base glyphs over variants.

methods.name: ps_unicodes_init
methods.description: Initializes a Unicode to glyph index mapping table, optionally adding extra glyphs and sorting.

methods.name: ps_unicodes_char_index
methods.description: Performs a binary search to find the glyph index for a given Unicode value.

methods.name: ps_unicodes_char_next
methods.description: Finds the next Unicode character and its glyph index after a given Unicode value.

methods.name: ps_get_macintosh_name
methods.description: Returns the Macintosh glyph name for a given index.

methods.name: ps_get_standard_strings
methods.description: Returns standard PostScript string names based on an identifier.

methods.name: psnames_get_service
methods.description: Retrieves a specific service interface from the module by service ID.
